elements.manual_reason: The mouse pointer is too small for the single union candidate box; at the end it rests near the top-right of the sidebar heading toward the browser toolbar (extension icon).
elements.label: Mouse pointer moving up from the article toward the browser toolbar

pattern.description: With the text still selected, the cursor travels up-right toward the Chrome extension icon; passing over the sidebar it briefly triggers Medium's author hover card, which pops in and vanishes within a few frames.
pattern.why_premium: Not premium craft in itself: an incidental hover artefact of an unedited screen recording. It is kept because the cursor path leads the eye to the extension the narration is about to use ('highlight what I want to include').

build_hint.gsap: Usually omit the stray popover in a recreation. If wanted: tl.to(cursor, {x: toolbarX, y: toolbarY, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).set(hoverCard, {autoAlpha: 1}, 0.1).set(hoverCard, {autoAlpha: 0}, 0.27).
build_hint.remotion: cursorPos = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 11], [p0, p1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); hover card visible only for frames start+3..start+8 (step, no spring).

notes: Motion energy is driven mostly by the transient hover card, which is absent from the settled end frame; b01 (union box) is the area it occupied. The card's top edge also briefly shows a different scroll state in f1637 (card positioned higher) before settling in f1638, suggesting it repositioned once. No SFX candidates.
